title: Pure Madoor
summary: The Madoor strategy revolves around high-DEF Spellcaster walls—Aqua Madoor (2000 DEF), Neo Aqua Madoor (3000 DEF), and Lightray Madoor (3000 DEF). Use Unexpected Dai to summon Aqua Madoor directly from the Deck alongside Secret Village of the Spellcasters to lock your opponent out of Spell Cards, then invert the board with Shield & Sword or Inverse Universe to turn your 3000 DEF Neo Aqua Madoor and Lightray Madoor into 3000 ATK finishers!

allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Level 4 Normal Monster Aqua Madoor directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Aqua Madoor from your Deck for an instant Rank 4 Xyz or Link-2 play.
allow.Magicians' Souls: Sends Level 6 Neo Aqua Madoor from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself as a Spellcaster body for Crowley and Selene.
allow.Secret Village of the Spellcasters: Field Spell that completely locks your opponent out of activating Spell Cards while you control a Madoor Spellcaster and they control no Spellcasters.
allow.Shield & Sword: Swaps the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters on the field until the End Phase, turning 2000 DEF Aqua Madoor and 3000 DEF Neo Aqua Madoor / Lightray Madoor into massive beatsticks.
allow.Inverse Universe: Normal Trap that permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field (giving Lightray Madoor a permanent 3000 ATK!).
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Secret Village of the Spellcasters.
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters and revives Neo Aqua Madoor or Lightray Madoor from your GY in Defense Position during either player's Main Phase.
allow.Crowley, the First Propheseer: Link-2 Spellcaster made with two Madoor Spellcasters that allows you to Normal Summon Level 5+ Spellcasters (Neo Aqua Madoor) without Tributing!
allow.Eria the Water Charmer, Gentle: Link-2 WATER Spellcaster summoned using Aqua Madoor that steals a WATER monster from your opponent's GY and searches on destruction.
allow.Performage Trapeze Magician: Rank 4 Spellcaster Xyz made with two Level 4 Spellcasters (Aqua Madoors) that grants an extra attack and prevents effect damage.

main: Aqua Madoor

Classic Level 4 WATER Spellcaster Normal Monster (1200 ATK / 2000 DEF): summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit to enable Secret Village of the Spellcasters and Spellcaster Xyz plays.
Neo Aqua Madoor
Level 6 WATER Spellcaster Normal Monster (1200 ATK / 3000 DEF): can be Normal Summoned with 0 Tributes via Crowley, the First Propheseer and reaches 3000 ATK under Shield & Sword.
Lightray Madoor

Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster Effect Monster (1200 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand when 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished, cannot be destroyed by battle once per turn, and becomes a 3000 ATK attacker under Inverse Universe or Shield & Sword.
Magicians' Souls
Sends Level 6 Neo Aqua Madoor from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself as a Spellcaster body for Crowley and Selene.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Aqua Madoor directly from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Aqua Madoor directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Secret Village of the Spellcasters
Prevents your opponent from activating any Spell Cards while you control a Madoor Spellcaster.
Shield & Sword
Swaps the original ATK and DEF of all monsters on the field, turning Neo Aqua Madoor and Lightray Madoor into 3000 ATK OTK threats.
Inverse Universe
Permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field, giving Lightray Madoor 3000 ATK and punishing high-ATK opposing bosses.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Secret Village of the Spellcasters.
extra: Link-2 Spellcaster (2 Spellcasters): allows you to Normal Summon Level 5+ Spellcaster Neo Aqua Madoor without Tributing!
Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 Spellcaster that revives Neo Aqua Madoor, Lightray Madoor, or Aqua Madoor from your GY during either player's Main Phase.
Link-2 WATER Spellcaster made with Aqua Madoor that revives a WATER monster from the opponent's GY.
Rank 4 Spellcaster Xyz made with two Level 4 Spellcasters that grants an extra attack.
